name: PINN arena: six architectures on six problems
description: PINNArenaBenchmark: the benchmark MLP, residual MLP, Fourier-feature MLP and SIREN on Burgers, Poisson, heat, wave, Allen-Cahn and Taylor-Green Navier-Stokes, 5000 epochs, 4000 collocation points, BC/IC weight 10; relative L2 and rank per problem (examples/benchmark_suite/12_physics_benchmark_suite.py; the script imports pinneapple_arena.benchmark, now pinneapple_tools.benchmark_suite.benchmark, whose default() takes every pointwise model of the registry; the VanillaPINN_S..SIREN names of its docstring are no longer registered). Quick: the script's --fast 100 epochs on heat and Burgers with the MLP and SIREN.
